title: qlpca: quasi-linear PCA in Python, with a replication of the PhD thesis
description: qlpca is a Python package for quasi-linear PCA (qlPCA): an extension of principal components analysis to nonlinear relations through low-order spline transformations of continuous variables, fitted by alternating least squares. The repository also contains a chapter-by-chapter replication of the PhD thesis in which the method was proposed (Lavado, 2012).
